question: I asked to cancel my subscription last week but I was charged again. What is your policy?
reply: Based on our policy, any charge posted after a valid cancellation request is eligible for a billing review. If a cancellation request was received but not applied, the request must be honored, and support may apply the earlier cancellation effectively from the original request date (available for requests made within the last 30 days) with your confirmation. Additionally, past charges are handled through a billing review rather than automatic refunds, and reviews are normally decided within 5 business days.
